items.title: ‘Script flipped’: ASX defies global AI falls
items.summary: Australia’s sharemarket has defied global carnage, closing marginally higher as AI capital expenditure fears hammered Wall Street and local mining stocks.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Sheds 600 Points As Oil Jumps; Samsara Breaks Out (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Dow Jones index drops 600 points Friday as oil prices rally. Bloom, MaxLinear and WDC are big earnings movers.

items.title: American Express is cutting 5% of its workforce to 'prepare for AI'
items.summary: Amex, which reported third-quarter results earlier Friday, is taking a $336 million restructuring charge in the quarter, CEO Stephen Squeri said Friday.

aus.headline: ASX Shrugs Off AI Sell-Off
aus.body: Local shares closed a touch higher while AI spending fears hit Wall Street and miners.
aus.why: Aussie shares held steady while global markets slid.

us.headline: Dow Drops 600 As Oil Jumps
us.body: The Dow fell 600 points on Friday as oil prices rallied.
us.why: Big Wall Street moves often set the tone for the ASX.

biz.headline: Amex Cuts 5% Of Staff For AI
biz.body: Amex is shedding 5% of its staff and taking a $336m restructuring hit.
biz.why: A sign of how big firms are reshaping jobs around AI.
